roomieRobotPqcPublicKeyHash().details: Kept for interface compatibility with the pre-audit ABI.

ADMIN_ORCHESTRATOR().notice: The ONLY wallet that may provision / rotate / freeze the Roomie robot credential         and drive operations. Hardcoded, cannot be transferred, cannot be renounced.

BONDING_CURVE_DAI_UNLOCK_TARGET().notice: 5 billion DAI (18 decimals) of real bonding-curve reserves unlocks the vault.

MAX_PROJECT_BPS_OF_VAULT().notice: No single project may reserve more than 20% of the unreserved vault.

MAX_TRANCHE_BPS_OF_VAULT().notice: No single 60-day tranche may exceed 2.5% of the vault balance at release time.

MIN_PROJECT_MILESTONES().notice: Every project is stretched over at least 6 tranches => at least 12 months.

OBS_TOKEN().notice: Obscura (OBS) on Arbitrum One. Verified: name "Obscura", symbol "OBS", 18 decimals.

TARGET_BEE_FLOURISHING_INDEX().notice: Global flourishing target. Operations continue indefinitely until this is met.

availableVaultBalance().notice: Vault OBS not already committed to a live project.

beeFlourishingIndex().notice: Cumulative, robot-attested bee flourishing index across all projects.

bondingCurveDaiReserves().notice: Reads the OBS bonding-curve DAI reserves directly from the OBS token contract.

canUpdateRobotConfig().notice: False once `revokeAndUpdateImmutability()` is signed. Never returns to true.

checkAndUnlockVault().notice: Permissionless. Unlocks the vault only when the curve genuinely holds 5B DAI.

checkProjectTimeout(uint256).notice: Permissionless timeout. Unspent funds return to the vault - they are never         destroyed and never become withdrawable outside the milestone path.

commissionRoomieRobot(bytes32,address,by.notice: Once the Roomie humanoid robot and its hybrid PQC MCU physically arrive, bind the         real credential: the PQC public key commitment, the classical secp256k1 leg, and         the post-quantum one-time-signature hash-chain tip.

completeProject(uint256).notice: A project can only be closed when the ENTIRETY of it is done: every mathematically         scheduled milestone delivered and every hardcoded mission outcome met.

executeProposal(uint256).notice: Permissionless execution of a passed proposal. The funding amount is whatever the         DAO voted on - it can never be chosen at execution time.

getTotalActiveLpSupply().notice: Live (unexpired) LP supply - the quorum denominator.

getVotingPower(address).notice: 1 LP = 1 vote. Returns 0 once the LP has expired.

issueMonthlyLpTokens(address,uint256).notice: Issue expiring LP. Hard cap of 100 LP per member per month, cumulative across all         calls in that month. Unused LP expires at the month boundary and is never carried.

lpSupplyByEpoch(uint256).notice: Live LP issued per epoch - the denominator for quorum.

nextMilestoneUnlockTime(uint256).notice: Next timestamp at which the robot may authorise this project again.

revokeAndUpdateImmutability().notice: FINAL, IRREVERSIBLE. After this transaction the robot credential - PQC public key,         MCU ECDSA signer and OTS chain - can never be changed by anyone, ever. The contract         becomes permanently immutable in configuration.

robotAuthorizeAndReleaseMilestone(uint25.notice: The single path by which OBS can ever leave this vault. Every one of these must hold:   - the bonding curve has genuinely collected 5B DAI;   - the Roomie robot MCU is commissioned;   - at most one authorisation per project per 60 days;   - hybrid PQC + ECDSA authorisation from the MCU (biometrics verified on the MCU itself);   - the hardcoded mission rules are attested as actually happening in the real world;   - the tranche is <= the project's mathematical per-milestone cap AND <= 2.5% of the vault. Funds go only to the payout recipient the DAO voted on. There is no arbitrary recipient.

setupRoomieRobotAndLock(bytes32).notice: Day one, immediately after deployment: anchor the placeholder / provisional PQC         public-key commitment. Callable the moment the contract exists.

syncVault().notice: Permissionless. Credits OBS sent to the vault by a plain `transfer`.

updateRobotPqcPublicKey(bytes32).notice: Rotate only the PQC public-key commitment (e.g. MCU firmware / key refresh).

vaultUnlocked().notice: Set by `checkAndUnlockVault()` once the OBS curve truly holds 5B DAI. One-way.
